bill.title: Recognizing July 28, 2026, as "World Hepatitis Day".
bill.latestActionText: Referred to the House Committee on Energy and Commerce.

classification.plainSummary: This is a resolution that would formally recognize July 28, 2026, as 'World Hepatitis Day.' It does not create new programs, change existing law, or impose any requirements. Resolutions of this type are ceremonial expressions of congressional sentiment.

plain.whatItDoes: No one has written a summary of this bill yet. All we have is its title, and a title is not a description of a law. To find out what it does, you have to open the bill itself.
plain.whoItTouches: We cannot tell from the labels on this bill who it reaches. The subject is too broad to say.
plain.everydayEffect: Nothing has changed yet. The title alone does not say what would change for you, and this tool will not guess. This kind of resolution does not become law, even if it passes.
plain.source: From the bill title, and from the subject labels that library staff put on it. There is no official summary of this bill yet.
